description:
Discontinued, superseded by Gen2. This page is kept as an archive record for owners and for anyone researching an older Cotic RocketMAX.

Years of production: 2016-2017

The RocketMAX Gen1 was the first big-wheeled Rocket. See the RocketMAX archive for the later generations, and the Rocket archive for its 27.5" sibling.

The RocketMAX took the high-speed ability of the Rocket and pushed it further. It kept everything that made the Rocket a proven race bike and went bigger: 140mm of droplink rear travel, built around 140 or 150mm forks at launch, and later retested and approved for 160mm forks.

MAX by name. The RocketMAX ran either 29" wheels with tyres up to 2.5" wide, or 27.5 Plus wheels with 2.8" tyres. Plus tyres rolled fast and gave extra grip and security for a small weight penalty. The 29" setup opened up a huge choice of tyres for every condition and purpose.

As a 29er, the RocketMAX proved its speed early. The Cotic Racing team took multiple UK Gravity Enduro and PMBA Elite podiums on the prototypes, and raced them in the Enduro World Series.

droplink suspension. The RocketMAX used Cotic's droplink layout, a linkage driven single pivot with a strong progression rate. The front end was Reynolds 853 for strength and durability, with a custom heat treated cromoly seat tube giving a very stiff base for the suspension pivots. The seatstays were steel too, which kept them slim for ankle, heel and calf clearance, and the droplink pivot hardware was custom ultra slim titanium. The swingarm was 7000 series aluminium, with CNC machined parts threading through the space between tyre and chainrings to put as much structure as possible into the brace area for rear end stiffness.

The details were all covered: Boost148 bolt thru rear end, taper steerer compatible head tube, ISCG05 mounts, sealed, capped and shielded pivots, precisely located hose routing, semi-internal gear routing, and both internal and external dropper post routing.

In short, it was an all round trail, all mountain and enduro bike: fleet footed, smooth rolling and grippy on the climbs, with a let's-do-this attitude on the way back down. Just as happy weaving through trees, chasing a stage time or flat out on an uplift day.

frame.derailleur_hanger: Syntace X-12 Type 1 (conventional or Shimano Direct Mount)
